sql: SELECT strategy, count(*) AS legs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='settled') AS settled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl<0) AS losses, round(coalesce(sum(pnl),0)::numeric,3) AS pnl, count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS games FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Rmmsell1','Rmmsell2') AND market_ticker LIKE 'KXNFL%' AND created_at >= '2026-09-20' GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY strategy
